proves.claim: newPackageFiles returns the cell anatomy as paths under packages/<name>, and the front door opens with a one-line doc comment carrying the purpose.

cli.logic-new-package.anatomy-paths.why: Without it, a generated cell could miss a door or its registry files, or lose its purpose line, unnoticed.

proves.claim: newPackageFiles refuses a name that is not lowercase kebab-case.

cli.logic-new-package.refuses-non-kebab.why: Without it, a bad name would create a folder no other tool can find.
